title: PAH-OMC-020 non-coordinate maximal-prefix coupling candidate
question: Can a non-coordinate maximal-prefix coupling give a common-space local realization for PAH-OMC-020 without using the obstructed coordinate density-ratio lift?
finding: Conditionally yes for the local N1 layer: maximal overlap of the exact prefix marginals followed by conditional expectation is a positive unital L2 contraction, and a diagonal prefix index m_n tending to infinity gives an explicit bounded-cylinder recovery bound. The candidate is researcher-owned only; source authorization, energy compatibility, N2b, N2c/N4, N2d and temporal convergence remain open.
decision_reason: This is a distinct non-coordinate construction rather than a repetition of the R-524 terminal-fibre calculation. It uses the R-510 bounded-measurable prefix modulus to select m_n before any energy estimate, makes the coupling kernel explicit, and separates what conditional Jensen proves from the unproved PAH form obligations.
boundary: PAH-001 functional, original rates, labelled Gibbs states, external unaccelerated Markov time and j-before-n order are frozen. The candidate is not a source-authorized owner packet, changes no model input, and makes no physical or infinite-volume claim.
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, PAH-OMC-020, R-510, R-512, the N2a intake contract, the N2b audit and R-524.
Use delta_(n,m)=min(1,4 D_m q^(n-m)) and m_n=max{m<n:delta_(n,m)<=1/(m+1)^2}; the fixed-m exponential factor proves the diagonal index escapes every fixed prefix.
Couple the two exact Lambda_(m_n) marginals by maximal overlap and extend tails through regular conditional laws; define U_n by conditional expectation from the finite state to H=L2(nu_infty).

Verify row/column marginals, total-variation mismatch, finite Jensen contraction, bounded-cylinder recovery and diagonal-index fixtures in independent and hostile lanes, with a finite Lean cross-check.
Keep source authorization, form-energy intertwining, N2b, N2c/N4, N2d and semigroup convergence as explicit missing fields.
next_action: Obtain source-owner authorization and a hash-pinned PAH-specific energy-intertwining estimate for this exact U_n; then test N2b, N2c/N4 and N2d once under the unchanged model.
